The '''''Commenor''''' was a cruiser in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The ''Commenor'' was was commanded by [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Pipalidi]], and saw action during the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]] in [[3643 BBY]].
